title: How to receive a Diamond Elite invitation
summary: This document explains how to receive a Diamond Elite invitation by maintaining a primary Rho-Bank savings relationship balance at or above $250,000 consistently. It advises consolidating funds, setting up deposits/transfers, keeping the account in good standing, and contacting the bank to request an eligibility review.
faqs: What minimum balance do I need to qualify for a Diamond Elite invitation?
Does the $250,000 requirement need to be consistent over time?
How can I consolidate funds to keep my primary savings relationship at $250,000?
What steps should I take to bring my balance to $250,000 and sustain it?
What account conditions could disqualify me (e.g., dropping below $250,000 or account not in good standing)?
If I maintained $250,000, how do I request a review for invitation eligibility?
